title: Primary garden area behind the street setback area
text: Primary garden area (applies to R30-R80; R100-SL; LR, MR and HR only). C1.1.3 A single consolidated primary garden area to be provided in accordance with Table 1.1b. Table 1.1b Primary garden area provisions. Location: Behind the street setback area(3). 3 Does not apply where C1.1.5 is met. C1.1.5 Notwithstanding C1.1.3, a single consolidated primary garden area may be located within the primary street setback area where any street walls or fences within the primary street setback area are visually permeable in accordance with C3.6.5 and C3.6.6.

exceptions.label: C1.1.5 single consolidated PGA in the primary street setback area with visually permeable street walls and fences

replaces.note: current: behind the primary street setback, no exception
